inputs.string_a:
Reference images are supplied in order, one per character. Reference 1 depicts the first character, Reference 2 the second, Reference 3 the third, Reference 4 the fourth. Each reference is authoritative ONLY for the character it depicts: reproduce that character's exact face shape and features, hair colour and style, eye colour, skin tone and body build. Never blend or average features between references, and never give one character another's features. Ignore any reference that is a blank or solid-colour square - it is an empty slot, not a character. Characters not covered by a reference may be designed freely. Only pose, framing, expression, clothing, lighting and setting may differ from the references.
If the scene below names the characters, match each named character to their reference by position.
